name: DataStewardPolicy
description: Strict Least-Privilege Policy for Data Steward (Checker / Reviewer): Review, approve, reject, or revoke business glossaries, metadata changes, and data quality rules. Explicit Deny on editing, creating, platform admin, and destructive infrastructure mutations.

rules.name: DATA_STEWARD-ViewAllRule
rules.description: Allow read-only view on all metadata assets

rules.name: DATA_STEWARD-ApprovalAndStatusRule
rules.description: Allow Data Steward to review, approve, reject, revoke glossary and metadata status. Explicitly restricted from editing content.

rules.name: DATA_STEWARD-DenyEditOperations
rules.description: Explicitly deny all editing and creation operations for Data Steward (Checker role: only review, approve, reject, revoke)

rules.name: DATA_STEWARD-TaskAndWorkflowRule
rules.description: Allow managing and resolving approval tasks and workflows

rules.name: DATA_STEWARD-DenyAdminAndSecurityResources
rules.description: Explicitly deny managing platform security, roles, policies, bots, and app definitions

rules.name: DATA_STEWARD-DenyDestructiveInfrastructureOps
rules.description: Explicitly deny destructive operations on core infrastructure services and schemas

rules.name: DATA_STEWARD-DenyDangerousGlobalOps
rules.description: Explicitly deny token generation, SCIM manipulation, role modification, and impersonation
